clue.text: Clash in nightclub hop involving rockers' leader

indicators.note: involving means the dance pair takes in a letter between its parts

parts.note: a disco is a nightclub for dancing
a hop is an informal dance

indicators.note: the leader of rockers is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A fight breaks out at a club dance when the head of a rock band turns up.
explanation.definitionFit: A clash of sounds or opinions is a lack of harmony, a synonym for discord.

clue.text: Stars, single, sold out

parts.note: single means one, the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: out signals the letters of sold are put out of order

explanation.surface: Pop stars have a single that has sold out completely.
explanation.definitionFit: Stars in the sense of celebrities who are adored are synonyms for heroes worshipped by fans.

clue.text: Pirate's reportedly bawdy song

indicators.note: reportedly signals that the phrase is to be heard as spoken, matching another word

parts.note: a bawdy song is a coarse air, coarse meaning vulgar and an air being a tune

explanation.surface: A buccaneer is said to sing a rude shanty.
explanation.definitionFit: A corsair was a privateer of the Barbary coast, so the word is a synonym for a sea raider.

clue.text: Angry about female being sacked

indicators.note: about means the angry word goes around the letter for female

parts.note: riled means annoyed or angry

explanation.surface: Someone is furious about a woman losing her job.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacked in the sense of plundered or ransacked is a synonym for having searched and robbed a place.

clue.text: CIA names suspect one might forget

indicators.note: suspect, read as an adjective, means the letters of the two words are not to be trusted in their order

explanation.surface: The intelligence agency names a suspect who might conveniently forget things.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone suffering memory loss is the person liable to forget, a descriptive definition.

clue.text: Stop farewell musical performance

parts.note: to can something is to stop it, as in can it
ta-ta is an informal goodbye

explanation.surface: An instruction to halt the goodbye song.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantata is a vocal composition with instruments, an example of a musical work performed.

clue.text: Chap only stays bonkers seeing shrink

indicators.note: bonkers means crazy, so the letters of the three words are mixed up wildly

explanation.surface: A man stays mad only while visiting a therapist.
explanation.walkthrough: Shrink is slang for a psychiatrist or analyst, which fits the bonkers surface neatly.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrink is informal slang for a mental health therapist, from headshrinker.

clue.text: Man with double trouble?

parts.note: a man married to two wives at once has twice the domestic trouble, and a crime to boot

explanation.surface: A man facing two sets of problems.
explanation.definitionFit: A man with two spouses at the same time commits the offence of double marriage, the trouble doubled.

clue.text: Arrangement of gold part encircling box

indicators.note: encircling means the gold-and-share pair wraps around the box word

parts.note: OR is the heraldic term for gold
a ration is a share or portion
a chest is a box

explanation.surface: A golden component arranged around a box, like a jeweller's design.
explanation.definitionFit: In music, the arrangement of a piece for the instruments of a band is its scoring for players.

clue.text: Head of state's miserable track record

indicators.note: head of means the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: poor can mean wretched or miserable

explanation.surface: A national leader has a dismal history in office.
explanation.walkthrough: Track record is read literally: the record left by an animal's track.
explanation.definitionFit: Spoor is the trail of footprints or droppings an animal leaves, literally the record of its tracks.

clue.text: Banker perhaps more extravagant keeping home

indicators.note: keeping means holding the word for home inside

parts.note: fancier means more elaborate or extravagant
in means at home

explanation.surface: A banker who spends more lavishly stays at home.
explanation.definitionFit: A banker is one example of a person who deals in money and investment, hence perhaps.

clue.text: Try to catch seafood with small shell-shaped instruments

parts.note: to try to catch fish is to cast a net

explanation.surface: Fishing for seafood leads to music from shells.
explanation.definitionFit: These clicking percussion pieces used in Spanish dance are shaped like a pair of shells.

clue.text: Teeming part of sea was hostile

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Seas full of life were rough and hostile.
explanation.definitionFit: A place full to overflowing is flooded or teeming with something, an idiomatic synonym.

clue.text: Awards zero marks?

parts.note: zero looks like the letter O
scars are marks left on the skin

explanation.surface: Prizes given out for no marks at all.
explanation.definitionFit: The Academy Awards for films are known by the name of their golden statuettes.

clue.text: Chap with band playing different version

parts.note: cove is old British slang for a man or chap
a ring is a band, as worn on a finger

explanation.surface: A man with his group plays an alternative rendition.
explanation.walkthrough: Band looks musical but is a finger ring; COVE is dated British slang for a fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: A band performing its own take on another artist's song is doing a cover of it.

clue.text: Fancies changes pocketing a grand

indicators.note: pocketing means the word for changes holds the next pieces inside

parts.note: varies means changes
G is slang shorthand for a grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: Whims shift once a thousand pounds is pocketed.
explanation.definitionFit: Fancies as whims or caprices are unpredictable notions, synonyms for these erratic changes.

clue.text: Ballet here almost describes 'heavenly'

indicators.note: describes is read as encloses, the words holding a stretch of their letters within them

explanation.surface: A critic calls this ballet nearly heavenly.
explanation.definitionFit: Something heavenly is delicate and otherworldly, a synonym for celestial lightness.

clue.text: Steer vehicle over Interstate opening

indicators.note: over means the vehicle word is turned back to front

parts.note: a van is a vehicle
I labels a US interstate highway, as in I-95
a gate is an opening in a fence or wall

explanation.surface: Driving a van over to the slip road onto an American highway.
explanation.walkthrough: Over reverses VAN to give NAV.
explanation.definitionFit: To steer a vessel or vehicle is to direct its course, a synonym.

clue.text: Rock old lady over sex with sweetheart

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the first piece sits above the next

parts.note: gran is a grandmother, an old lady
it is a coy word for sex
the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter

explanation.surface: Granny is shaken over a racy affair with a lover.
explanation.definitionFit: Granite is a hard igneous stone, an example of rock.

clue.text: Brilliant time with Queen's family

parts.note: lit means lit up, bright
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen's cipher

explanation.surface: A splendid occasion with the royal family.
explanation.definitionFit: A litter is a group of young animals born together, the brood or family of one mother.

clue.text: One, after catching a cold, is woolly

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: catching means the following word holds the next pieces

parts.note: next means after, following
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone who has caught a chill is wrapped in wool.
explanation.definitionFit: Woolly in the sense of vague or fuzzy thinking means imprecise.

clue.text: Switch end, playing

parts.note: a butt is the end of something, as of a cigarette
on means playing or performing

explanation.surface: Swapping ends while a game is in progress.
explanation.definitionFit: A switch is a control you press, an everyday synonym for a push control.

clue.text: Initially little animal resting, virtually adult

definitions.text: Initially little animal resting, virtually adult

indicators.note: initially means the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A tiny creature at rest, almost fully grown.
explanation.definitionFit: A grub or caterpillar is the small immature stage of an insect before it becomes an adult.

clue.text: Former cab company worker getting rich

parts.note: ex means former
Uber is a ride-hailing taxi firm
an ant is a worker, as in a worker ant

explanation.surface: An ex-taxi worker is getting wealthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Rich in the sense of lush and abundant, like luxuriant growth, matches this word.

clue.text: Cooking range popular once more

parts.note: an Aga is a British brand of cast-iron range cooker
in means popular or fashionable

explanation.surface: A kitchen stove is fashionable again.
explanation.walkthrough: An Aga is a heavy British range cooker found in country kitchens.
explanation.definitionFit: Once more and the answer are straightforward synonyms for a repeat occurrence.

clue.text: Feeling excited, blokes consumed by computing?

parts.note: sent means thrilled or carried away

indicators.note: consumed by means the word for blokes goes inside the next one

parts.note: IT is information technology, computing
men are blokes

explanation.surface: Men thrilled by a passion for computers.
explanation.definitionFit: A feeling is an emotion or attitude, a synonym for this word.

clue.text: Middle of state hit by old battle

indicators.note: middle of picks the centre letter of the next word

parts.note: lam means to hit or thrash

explanation.surface: The heart of the state was struck by an old war.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alamo was the 1836 siege in Texas, an example of a famous battle.

clue.text: Flooding a lot? These could be useful

parts.note: welling means rising up and flooding out
tons means a great deal

explanation.surface: When water floods everywhere these boots would come in handy.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubber boots are what you would want on when there is a lot of flooding, so they are useful then.
